senses.title: Cover the same surface
senses.definition: to cover part of the same area of a surface as another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一物覆盖同一块表面的一部分
senses.example: The two labels overlap slightly at the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 两张标签在角上略微重叠。
senses.why: Over- here means across or above, and lap means to fold or lay one thing over another. A layer laid across the edge of another shares a strip of surface with it, and that strip is the overlap.
senses.whyCN: over- 在这里是“越过、在上”，lap 是“折叠、把一层搭到另一层上”。一层越过另一层的边缘搭上去，两者就共用一条表面，这条共用的带子就是重叠。

senses.title: Share part of the same period
senses.definition: to happen during part of the same period as something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事发生在同一段时间的一部分
senses.example: My lecture overlaps with the lab session on Thursday.
senses.exampleCN: 周四我的讲座和实验课时间重叠。
senses.why: When layers become schedules, the shared strip becomes shared minutes. The geometry is unchanged: two stretches laid along one line share a middle segment.
senses.whyCN: 当“层”变成“日程”，共用的那条带子就变成了共用的分钟。几何关系没有变：两条线段铺在同一条时间线上，中间有一段是双方都占着的。

senses.title: Share part of a range
senses.definition: to share part of a range of values, topics, or interests
senses.definitionCN: 在一段数值、话题或兴趣范围中有一部分相同
senses.example: Their research interests overlap in cognitive science.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的研究兴趣在认知科学上重叠。
senses.why: A range is a line with limits. Two ranges that share a stretch of that line overlap exactly as two strips share a band of surface, which is why the same word serves for both.
senses.whyCN: 范围是一条有端点的时间轴或数轴。两段范围共用其中一截，就像两条带子共用一段表面一样，因此同一个词可以同时用于空间、时间和抽象范围。

senses.title: Share duties: jobs that claim the same tasks
senses.titleCN: 职责重叠：两个岗位claim同一批任务
senses.definition: of jobs or responsibilities, to include the same tasks or territory
senses.definitionCN: 指岗位或职责包含同一批任务、同一片权责范围
senses.example: The two roles overlap, so one person could cover both.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个岗位职责重叠，一个人就能兼顾。
senses.why: Duties are territories drawn around tasks. When two job descriptions claim the same task, their territories share a zone; managers then redraw the boundaries to remove the overlap.
senses.whyCN: 职责是围绕任务划出的地盘。两份岗位说明都声称管同一件事时，它们的地盘就出现共用区；管理者随后要重划边界，消掉这块重叠。

senses.title: The shared part itself
senses.definition: the area, period, or set of items that two things both include
senses.definitionCN: 两个事物同时包含的区域、时段或项目集合
senses.example: The overlap between the two plans is small.
senses.exampleCN: 两个计划之间重叠的部分很小。
senses.why: English often turns the place where two things meet into a noun. The verb describes the laying across; the noun names the strip that results, as if you could point at it on a map.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把“两物相接之处”直接名词化。动词描述“搭过去”的动作，名词则指动作留下的那条带子，仿佛能在地图上指出来。

senses.title: How much is shared: measured overlap
senses.titleCN: 重叠量：被度量的重合程度
senses.definition: the extent to which two things cover the same ground, often given as a proportion
senses.definitionCN: 两个事物覆盖同一范围的程度，常以比例表示
senses.example: There is a 30 percent overlap between the two datasets.
senses.exampleCN: 两个数据集有百分之三十的重叠。
senses.why: Once the shared zone can be pointed at, it can be measured. Statistics and design turn the strip into a number, so overlap becomes a degree rather than a place.
senses.whyCN: 共用区一旦能被指出来，就能被测量。统计学与设计把这条带子变成一个数字，于是重叠从“一个地方”变成了“一个程度”。

senses.title: Printing and imaging: lay one layer over another
senses.titleCN: 印刷与影像：一层压在一层上
senses.definition: in printing and image editing, to place or print one layer partly over another
senses.definitionCN: 在印刷与图像编辑中，把一层部分地压在另一层上
senses.example: The poster overlaps the photo with a red block.
senses.exampleCN: 海报用一个红色色块压住了照片的一部分。
senses.why: This is the craft sense at its most literal: ink or film laid across the edge of another layer. Where the two layers meet, the colours combine and the shared band darkens, which is exactly the image behind the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最字面的手艺义：油墨或胶片越过另一层的边缘压上去。两层相接处颜色叠加、共用带变深，正是这个词背后的原始画面。

senses.title: Handover overlap: both present for a while
senses.titleCN: 交接重叠期：两任同时在岗
senses.definition: a period when the outgoing and incoming person are both at work so that knowledge can pass between them
senses.definitionCN: 离任者与接任者同时在岗的一段时间，以便经验传递
senses.example: The new manager had a two-week overlap with her predecessor.
senses.exampleCN: 新经理与前任有两周的重叠期。
senses.why: In time, the shared strip can be deliberately arranged. It is the only window in which tacit knowledge can be shown rather than written down, so organizations schedule an overlap instead of a clean cut.
senses.whyCN: 在时间上，这条共用带子可以被刻意安排出来。它是默会知识能够“演示”而不是“写成文件”的唯一窗口，所以组织会安排一段重叠，而不是一刀切地换人。

intro.en: Overlap is a native English compound of two old words. The dates are recorded first uses, and the deeper origin of lap is not certain.
intro.cn: overlap 是两个古老英语本族词构成的复合词。年代为首次记录时间；lap 的更早来源并不确定。

items.en: The phrase lap over is recorded meaning 'to lie partly on or over something'. The image is a cloth or board laid across the edge of another.
items.cn: 短语 lap over 记录于 17 世纪 30 年代，意为“部分地搭在某物之上”。画面是一块布或木板越过另一物的边缘搭上去。

items.en: The single verb overlap appears, meaning 'to lay so as to cover part of something else'. It is formed by reversing the phrase: over + lap.
items.cn: 合为一体的动词 overlap 出现于 1726 年，意为“铺盖住另一物的一部分”。它由短语的词序调转而来：over + lap。

items.en: The noun overlap is recorded, first as the act of overlapping and then as the part that is shared.
items.cn: 名词 overlap 记录于 1813 年，先指“重叠这个动作”，后指“被共用的那部分”。

items.en: Technical use spreads: overlapping boards in shipbuilding, overlapping strata in geology, overlapping genes in genetics, and overlapping segments in phonology.
items.cn: 技术用法扩散开来：造船中的搭接板、地质学中的重叠地层、遗传学中的重叠基因、音系学中的重叠音段。

items.en: The figurative senses dominate now: overlapping interests, overlapping duties, and a scheduled overlap between two job holders. The physical strip remains the model for all of them.
items.cn: 如今占主导的是引申义：兴趣重叠、职责重叠、两任岗位之间的交接重叠期。那条物理上的共用带子仍是所有用法的模型。

note.en: The first group is about shape: over- words that do not mean sharing a zone. The second is about meaning: words for things that meet, cross, or repeat.
note.cn: 第一组看外形：同样带 over- 却不表示“共用一块区域”的词。第二组看词义：表示相接、相交或重复的词。

entries.definition: to lie over or on top of something, especially in layers of rock. It stresses one layer covering another, not a shared strip.
entries.definitionCN: 覆盖在……之上，尤指岩层。它强调一层盖住另一层，而不是共用一条带子。

entries.definition: to cover the surface of something with a layer, or the layer itself. The covering can be complete, while overlap is only partial.
entries.definitionCN: 在某物表面覆上一层，或指那一层本身。覆盖可以是完全的，而 overlap 只是部分的。

entries.definition: to load too much, or an excessive load. It shares the over- prefix but has nothing to do with shared area.
entries.definitionCN: 超载；装载过多。它同样带 over-，但与“共用区域”无关。

entries.definition: to look down on something from above, or to fail to notice it. Its over- is about position or neglect, not coverage.
entries.definitionCN: 俯瞰；忽视。它的 over- 表示位置或忽略，而不是覆盖。

entries.definition: to happen at the same time or occupy the same space exactly. It stresses simultaneous or identical position; overlap stresses a shared part.
entries.definitionCN: 同时发生，或完全占据同一空间。它强调同时或位置完全一致；overlap 强调“共有一部分”。

entries.definition: to cross or cut through each other, or to share common elements in set theory. Crossing produces a line or point; overlapping produces an area.
entries.definitionCN: 相交、交叉，或在集合论中有共同元素。交叉产生的是线或点，重叠产生的是面积。

entries.definition: to make an exact copy, or an exact copy itself. Complete sameness is the point, whereas overlap allows each side to keep something of its own.
entries.definitionCN: 复制；完全相同的副本。重点在“完全一样”，而重叠允许双方各自保留一部分。

entries.definition: to place one image or layer on top of another so that both remain visible. It is the technical cousin of the printing sense of overlap.
entries.definitionCN: 把一个影像或一层叠在另一层上，且两者都仍然可见。它是 overlap 印刷义的技术近亲。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks built on sound and spelling, then three abstract images for the idea of a shared strip.
normalIntro.cn: 先用五个读音与拼写挂钩，再用三个抽象画面记住“共用一条带子”这个观念。

normal.en: lap is the knee: a book lies across your lap. Over-lap is one thing lying across another, sharing a strip.
normal.cn: lap 是“膝上”：书横放在膝上。over-lap 就是一物横搭在另一物上，共用一条带子。

normal.en: The verb is stressed at the back, the noun at the front: overLAP the sheets, but close the OVERlap. The heavier stress marks the action.
normal.cn: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前：overLAP 两张纸，但收拢 OVERlap。重音落在动作上。

normal.en: Hear the hyphen: over-lap means crossing the edge and lapping onto the other side.
normal.cn: 想象那个连字符：over-lap 就是越过边缘、搭到另一侧去。

normal.en: Picture a Venn diagram: the dark lens in the middle is the overlap, and both circles can point at it.
normal.cn: 想一个维恩图：中间那块深色透镜就是重叠部分，两个圆都能指向它。

normal.en: Shift change at a factory: the ten minutes when both crews are on the floor is the overlap.
normal.cn: 工厂交接班：两个班组同时站在车间里的那十分钟，就是 overlap。

abstract.en: Overlap is not similarity. It is a real shared interval that both sides can occupy at once.
abstract.cn: 重叠不是“相似”。它是一段双方都能同时占用的真实共用区间。

abstract.en: Cooperation starts in the overlap: the small zone of shared interest is the only ground on which two plans can be signed.
abstract.cn: 合作从重叠处开始：那一小块共同利益，是两个计划唯一能签字的地面。

abstract.en: Shared time is the one resource that cannot be returned. If two things overlap, they must be carried together.
abstract.cn: 共用的时间是无法退还的资源。两件事一旦重叠，就只能一起承担。

examples.en: The two circles overlap, and the shaded lens is where both claims hold.
examples.cn: 两个圆重叠，阴影的透镜形区域就是两种主张都成立的地方。

examples.en: Her new job overlaps with the old one for a month, which is enough time to hand over the files.
examples.cn: 她的新工作与旧工作有一个月的重叠期，足够交接文件。

examples.en: When the duties of two departments overlap, someone has to decide who answers the phone.
examples.cn: 当两个部门的职责重叠时，总得有人决定谁来接电话。

dict_mnemonic.note: 把 over 记成“越过、在上”，lap 记成“搭、叠”：越过边界搭上一块，就是重叠。
dict_mnemonic.text: over（越过、在上）+ lap（搭叠）→ 部分重叠；重叠部分、重叠量

root: over（在上、越过）+ lap（搭、折叠）；lap 的更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: The senses start with two surfaces sharing a strip, move the same strip through time and then through abstract ranges and duties, then name the strip and measure it, and end with the two technical uses where the strip is deliberate: printing layers and a job handover.
sensesIntro.cn: 这些义项从“两块表面共用一条带子”开始，把同一条带子依次移到时间、抽象范围与职责上，再把它名词化并加以度量，最后落到两种刻意安排的带子：印刷叠层与岗位交接。

core.en: Two sheets laid across each other, leaving one darker shared band
core.cn: 两张错开叠放的薄片，留下一条颜色更深的共用带

branches.en: Physical sharing: two surfaces cover the same patch.
branches.cn: 物理共用：两块表面覆盖同一片区域。

branches.en: Time sharing: an accidental clash of schedules, or a deliberate handover window.
branches.cn: 时间共用：日程的意外相撞，或刻意留出的交接窗口。

branches.en: Abstract sharing: interests that meet, and duties that claim the same task.
branches.cn: 抽象共用：相交的兴趣，以及争夺同一任务的两份职责。

branches.en: The strip named, then the strip measured as a proportion.
branches.cn: 先给这条带子命名，再把它度量成一个比例。

branches.en: Literal layering: ink or film pressed across another layer, darkening the shared band.
branches.cn: 字面叠层：油墨或胶片压过另一层，使共用带变深。

intro.en: Overlap sits in the huge over- family and the small lap family. Both halves are native English, so there is no Latin root here.
intro.cn: overlap 属于庞大的 over- 词族，也属于小小的 lap 词族。两半都是英语本族词，因此这里没有拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entry applies: over is Old English ofer, from Proto-Germanic *uber (PIE *uper); lap is a Germanic verb of uncertain deeper origin.
latinIntro.cn: 不适用拉丁词条：over 是古英语 ofer，来自原始日耳曼语 *uber（原始印欧语 *uper）；lap 是一个日耳曼语动词，其更早来源不确定。

items.meaning: to cover part of the same area, time, or range
items.meaningCN: 部分覆盖同一区域、时段或范围
items.example: The two schedules overlap on Friday.

items.structure: same compound used as a noun
items.meaning: the shared part; the extent of sharing
items.example: The overlap is only ten percent.
items.exampleCN: 重叠部分只有百分之十。

items.meaning: sharing part of the same area or range
items.example: The two overlapping claims caused a dispute.
items.exampleCN: 两项重叠的主张引发了争议。

items.meaningCN: 被部分覆盖的；交叠起来的
items.example: The overlapped boards kept the rain out.
items.exampleCN: 交叠搭接的木板挡住了雨。

items.meaning: sharing no area or range at all
items.exampleCN: 这两个群体完全没有重叠。

items.meaning: across, above, beyond, or too much
to fold or lay one thing over another
items.meaningCN: 折叠；把一物搭在另一物上
items.example: Lap the edge of the cloth over the seam.

items.meaning: a joint where one part falls short of covering another
items.meaningCN: 下搭接；欠重叠（工程中相接不足的接缝）
items.example: The engineer measured the underlap of the plates.
items.exampleCN: 工程师测量了钢板的欠重叠量。

items.meaning: in a way that shares part of the same area or range
items.example: The two terms are used overlappingly in the literature.
items.exampleCN: 文献中这两个术语被重叠地使用。

definition_zh: 忽略；未注意；俯瞰；宽容；监督
definition_en: to fail to notice something, to have a view over a place from above, to forgive a fault, or in older use to watch over work or people
core_image: 山腰旅店朝西的窗，窗下是一片屋瓦和几条窄巷
scene: 山腰的旅店有一扇朝西的窗，窗下是一片屋瓦和几条窄巷。From the terrace you can overlook the whole harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 overlook 是「俯瞰」（第 2 个义项：从高处望下去）；句意为从平台上可以把整个港口尽收眼底，画面是那扇朝西的窗与窗下的屋瓦。

pos.zh: 忽略；未注意；俯瞰；宽容；监督

derivatives.zh: 由 overlook 加过去分词词尾 -ed 构成，义为「被忽略的」
由 overlook 加表示人的后缀 -er 构成，义为「监工；监督者」，多见于旧时纺织业记载

senses.title: To fail to notice something
senses.definition: to fail to see or consider something important, usually without intending to
senses.definitionCN: 没能看到或考虑到重要的事，通常并非有意
senses.example: The report overlooks one important detail.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告漏掉了一个重要细节。
senses.why: The verb pictures an eye sweeping over a surface; whatever the sweep passes across without stopping is literally looked over, and that is the root of the modern sense of missing it.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词画的是目光扫过一整片表面；凡是目光扫过却没有停下的地方，就是字面地被「看过而越过」，现代「漏看」义正由此而来。

senses.title: To have a view over a place from above
senses.definition: to be built or placed high enough to give a view down onto a place
senses.definitionCN: 建得或放得足够高，可以从上面望见某处
senses.example: Her office overlooks the river.
senses.exampleCN: 她的办公室可以俯瞰那条河。
senses.why: Here the eye really does travel over the whole scene from a height, so the word keeps its oldest physical meaning instead of turning it into a mistake.
senses.whyCN: 这里目光确实从高处扫过整片景物，所以这个词保留着最古老的身体经验，没有把它变成一种过失。

senses.title: To forgive a fault
senses.definition: to choose not to punish or complain about a fault, as if deciding not to see it
senses.definitionCN: 选择不处罚、不追究某个过失，好像决定不去看它
senses.example: The manager decided to overlook the late arrival.
senses.exampleCN: 经理决定不计较那次迟到。
senses.why: Forgiving is pictured as letting the eye pass over a fault without stopping on it; the same sweep that causes a genuine miss becomes, by choice, an act of leniency.
senses.whyCN: 宽恕被画成让目光从过失上滑过、不停留；同一次「扫过」，无意时是漏看，存心时就成了宽待。

senses.title: To watch over work or people
senses.definition: in older use, to keep an eye on workers or a process and make sure things are done properly
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的用法里指盯着工人或某道工序，确保事情做得妥当
senses.example: An old woman overlooked the girls at their sewing.
senses.exampleCN: 一位老妇人照看着这些姑娘做针线。
senses.why: A person standing above a workshop sees every bench at once, so the word for a wide view also served for supervision before oversee took over that job.
senses.whyCN: 站在作坊高处的人能一眼看见每张工作台，所以表示「放眼望全」的词也承担过监督之职，后来这份差事才交给 oversee。

intro.en: Overlook is an English compound of over and look; its story is the double edge of a gaze that sweeps across everything and therefore may stop on nothing.
intro.cn: overlook 是 over 与 look 的英语复合词，它的来历是一道目光的两面：既扫过全部，也可能什么都不停留。

items.en: Over and look are both inherited Germanic words, so the compound was formed in English rather than borrowed from French or Latin.
items.cn: over 与 look 都是日耳曼语固有词，所以这个复合词形成于英语内部，并非借自法语或拉丁语。

items.en: The recorded verb oferlocian meant to look over something, with the eye passing across a whole surface.
items.cn: 有记录的动词 oferlocian 意为「看过某物」，目光扫过整片表面。

items.en: Middle English overlooken kept the wide view and also began to mean passing over a thing without stopping on it.
items.cn: 中古英语 overlooken 保留「放眼望过」，也开始表示从某物上掠过而不再停留。

items.en: Two seemingly opposite senses grew from the same sweep of the eye: watching over a place, and letting a fault go by.
items.cn: 两个看似相反的义项从同一次扫视里长出来：一个是看住一处地方，一个是把过失放过去。

items.en: Modern English keeps the view from above, the failure to notice and the mild forgiveness, while the supervising sense has grown rare.
items.cn: 现代英语保留从高处望下去、漏看与轻微宽容三个义项，监督义则已少见。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers inflected forms and other words built with the same prefix; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of ignoring, of viewing and of forgiving.
note.cn: 形近组收各种屈折形式与同一前缀构成的其他词；近义组收表示忽略、观看与宽恕的动词。

entries.definition: The past form, also used as an adjective for something not noticed.
entries.definitionCN: 过去式，也作形容词指未被注意的。

entries.definition: The present participle, often used of a building with a view.
entries.definitionCN: 现在分词，常用于描述有景可望的建筑。

entries.definition: To supervise work or people and make sure it is done properly.
entries.definitionCN: 监督管理或人员，确保事情做得妥当。

entries.definition: A failure to notice something, or the act of supervising.
entries.definitionCN: 未注意到某事，或监督这件事本身。

entries.definition: To pay no attention to something on purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 故意不去理会某事。

entries.definition: To fail to give proper care or attention to something.
entries.definitionCN: 未能给予应有的照料或注意。

entries.definition: To stop being angry with someone for a fault.
entries.definitionCN: 因某个过失而不再生某人的气。

entries.definition: To look carefully over a whole area or scene.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细察看一整片区域或景象。

normalIntro.en: The word is over plus look, and its hooks return to a gaze that covers everything, to the height it needs, and to what it chooses not to see.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 over 加 look，记忆钩子都回到那道覆盖一切的目光、它需要的高度，以及它选择不看的东西。

normal.en: Overlook is over plus look, so the eye is pictured moving across a surface rather than fixing on a point.
normal.cn: overlook 是 over 加 look，画面里目光扫过一整片表面，而不是停在一点上。

normal.en: A building that overlooks the sea really does have that view, which is why the oldest sense survives unchanged.
normal.cn: 俯瞰大海的房子确实有那片景，所以最老的义项原样活了下来。

normal.en: The same sweep explains the mistake: what the eye passes over is not registered.
normal.cn: 同一次扫视也解释了过失：目光掠过的东西没有被记下。

normal.en: Forgiving adds a choice to the same picture, since the fault is deliberately allowed to pass.
normal.cn: 宽恕在同一幅画上加了选择：过失被故意放了过去。

normal.en: Oversee and oversight show that supervision once shared this prefix's wide view.
normal.cn: oversee 与 oversight 说明监督原本也共享这个前缀的「放眼望全」。

abstract.en: A window above a harbour with roofs and alleys below is the word as pure view.
abstract.cn: 港口上方的窗，下面是屋瓦与窄巷，就是这个词作为纯粹视野的样子。

abstract.en: A clerk running a finger down a list and skipping a line shows how a view becomes an error.
abstract.cn: 职员手指顺着名单下滑、跳过一行，显示视野如何变成错误。

abstract.en: A manager closing a file without a word turns the same skipped line into mercy.
abstract.cn: 经理一言不发合上卷宗，把同一行被跳过的地方变成了宽容。

examples.en: The report overlooks one important detail.
examples.cn: 这份报告漏掉了一个重要细节。

examples.en: Her office overlooks the river.
examples.cn: 她的办公室可以俯瞰那条河。

examples.en: The manager decided to overlook the late arrival.
examples.cn: 经理决定不计较那次迟到。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧沃路克」——欧沃站在高处往下看，看得远，也容易漏看。

root: overlook 由古英语 ofer（在上、越过）与 lōcian（看）合成，字面为「从上面看过去」；两半都是日耳曼语固有词，没有可靠的拉丁同族词。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a gaze sweeping across a whole scene; the senses split into seeing everything from above, missing one thing in the sweep, forgiving by choice, and the old duty of watching over work.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是一道扫过整片景物的目光；义项分成从高处看见全部、扫视中漏掉一处、存心放过过失，以及旧时看管工作的职责。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a west-facing window in a hillside inn, roofs and narrow alleys lying below it.
core.cn: 核心意象：山腰旅店朝西的窗，窗下摊着屋瓦与窄巷。

branches.en: a finger running down a list and skipping a line
branches.cn: 手指顺名单下滑、跳过一行

branches.en: a window above a harbour full of roofs
branches.cn: 港口上方看得见满片屋瓦的窗

branches.en: a manager quietly closing the file
branches.cn: 经理悄悄合上卷宗

branches.en: an old woman watching a row of sewing girls
branches.cn: 老妇人看着一排做针线的姑娘

branches.en: one skipped line, once an error and once a kindness
branches.cn: 同一行被跳过的地方，一次是错，一次是情

intro.en: The word sets the Old English prefix for over before the verb to look, and the same pieces recur in oversee, oversight and the inflected forms.
intro.cn: 这个词把古英语中表示「在上」的前缀放在动词「看」前面，同样的部件还出现在 oversee、oversight 与各屈折形式里。

latinIntro.en: This compound is native Germanic and has no Latin family of its own; Latin super is a distant relative of the prefix, not a member of this word's history.
latinIntro.cn: 这个复合词是日耳曼语固有词，本身没有拉丁词族；拉丁语 super 只是前缀的远亲，不属于这个词的来历。

definition_zh: 海外的；国外的；在海外；向海外；（总称）海外地区
definition_en: located, happening, or living across the sea in a foreign country; also the foreign countries taken together as a region
core_image: 站在海岸线上，越过一条水带望向另一块陆地
scene: 港口堆场里，贴着外文标签的集装箱被吊上货轮。The shipping clerk wrote overseas on the destination line, and the crane lifted the last box toward the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 overseas 是「海外的、国外的」（第 1 个义项：位于国外）；句意：报关员在目的地一栏写下“海外”，吊机把最后一个箱子吊向大海。图中可辨识物件：集装箱、外文标签、吊机、货轮、报关单、海平线；对应第 1 个义项。

derivatives.zh: 海外的（较早的变体拼法）
总部或驻地在海外的
在海外受训的
驶往海外的；发往国外的
在海外出生的

senses.title: Across the sea: located abroad
senses.definition: located or based in a country across the sea from the speaker's own
senses.definitionCN: 位于说话者本国之外、隔海相望的国家
senses.example: The company has three overseas branches.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司有三家海外分公司。
senses.why: Over- means across or beyond, and sea is the water between the two shores. The reference point is always the speaker's own coast; what matters lies on the far side of the water.
senses.whyCN: over- 是“越过、在那边”，sea 是两岸之间的水。参照点始终是说话者自己这一侧的海岸，重要的事物在水的那一边。

senses.title: Coming from abroad
senses.definition: coming from or belonging to a foreign country
senses.definitionCN: 来自外国或属于外国的
senses.example: Overseas visitors filled the museum.
senses.exampleCN: 海外游客挤满了博物馆。
senses.why: Here the direction reverses: the word marks not where the thing sits but where it came from. The sea is still the divider, only now the traffic crosses toward the speaker.
senses.whyCN: 这里方向反了过来：词标记的不是事物所在之处，而是它来自何处。海仍是分界，只是人流物流朝说话者这一侧越过来。

senses.title: Abroad: the adverbial direction
senses.definition: to or in a country across the sea
senses.definitionCN: 到海外，或在海外
senses.example: She moved overseas after graduation.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业后她移居海外。
senses.why: English lets the same compound serve as an adverb without adding -ly. The phrase names a path, and the path crosses water, so no separate adverb form was ever needed.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许同一个复合词直接作副词，不必加 -ly。这个短语命名的是一条路径，而路径要越过水，因此从来不需要另造副词形式。

senses.title: The overseas as a named region
senses.definition: the countries beyond the sea, taken together as a region or sphere of activity
senses.definitionCN: 隔海之外的国家，作为一个地区或活动领域的总称
senses.example: Sales in the overseas grew faster than at home.
senses.exampleCN: 海外市场的销售增长快于国内。
senses.why: A locational phrase can be nominalized: the far side stops being a direction and becomes a territory with a name. Business and journalism then speak of the overseas as a single place with its own figures.
senses.whyCN: 方位短语可以名词化：那边不再是方向，而变成一块有名字的地盘。商业与新闻于是把“海外”当作一个有自己的数字的单一地方来谈。

senses.title: Foreign affairs: the official sphere
senses.definition: relating to a country's interests and activities beyond its borders
senses.definitionCN: 涉及一国国境之外的利益与活动
senses.example: The ministry handles overseas affairs.
senses.exampleCN: 该部负责海外事务。
senses.why: Bureaucracy names the foreign sphere as an adjective, and activities there become a department's remit. The word turns geography into an administrative portfolio.
senses.whyCN: 官僚体系用形容词命名对外领域，那边的活动就变成一个部门的职责。这个词把地理变成了一份行政分工。

senses.title: Living abroad: of people
senses.definition: of a person or community, living in a foreign country
senses.definitionCN: 指个人或群体侨居外国
senses.example: Overseas Chinese communities kept the festival alive.
senses.exampleCN: 海外华人社群把这个节日保留了下来。
senses.why: For people the compound marks residence rather than origin: the person's daily life has moved to the far shore, even if the passport and the language have not.
senses.whyCN: 用于人时，这个词标记的是“居住地”而不是“来源地”：此人的日常生活已经移到海那边，即使护照与语言没有跟着变。

senses.title: Military deployment beyond the sea
senses.definition: of troops or bases, stationed in a foreign country
senses.definitionCN: 指部队或基地驻扎在外国
senses.example: The unit served on overseas deployment for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 这支部队在海外部署了一年。
senses.why: Armies inherit the maritime image even when they fly. Overseas still means outside the home territory, and the word keeps military language politely vague about which country is meant.
senses.whyCN: 军队即使坐飞机也继承了这个航海意象。overseas 仍指本国领土之外，同时让军事语言礼貌地含糊，不必点明是哪一个国家。

senses.title: Historical euphemism: the colonies
senses.definition: in British usage, a polite word for the colonies and dominions, especially in the early twentieth century
senses.definitionCN: 英国用法中，对殖民地与自治领的委婉说法，尤见于 20 世纪早期
senses.example: Wartime posters promised work in the overseas dominions.
senses.exampleCN: 战时海报承诺在海外自治领有工作机会。
senses.why: Overseas let speakers avoid the word colony. Distance across water replaced a political relationship that many preferred not to name, which is how a neutral geographic term became an instrument of imperial tact.
senses.whyCN: overseas 让说话者避开“colony”这个词。隔海的距离替代了一段许多人不想点明的政治关系，于是一个中性的地理词变成了帝国辞令里的委婉工具。

intro.en: Overseas is a native English compound of over and sea. The word is transparent, but the deeper origin of sea itself is not certain.
intro.cn: overseas 是 over 与 sea 构成的英语本族复合词。词形透明，但 sea 本身的更早来源并不确定。

items.en: The older form oversea is recorded as an adjective and adverb meaning 'across the sea, on the other side of the sea'.
items.cn: 较早的形式 oversea 记录于 15 世纪，作形容词与副词，意为“隔海、在海的那一边”。

items.en: Overseas appears with the same meaning and eventually displaces oversea in most contexts. Both are simply over + sea.
items.cn: overseas 于 16 世纪 80 年代出现，意义相同，最终在多数语境中取代 oversea。两者都只是 over + sea。

items.en: British imperial usage makes overseas a euphemism for the colonies and dominions, especially during the First World War.
items.cn: 英国帝国用语把 overseas 变成殖民地与自治领的委婉说法，尤在第一次世界大战期间。

items.en: The noun use is recorded: the overseas as the collective name for territories beyond the sea.
items.cn: 名词用法记录于 1919 年：the overseas 作为隔海之外领土的集合名称。

items.en: Trade, education, and the military keep the word busy: overseas market, overseas students, overseas deployment. The geographic frame stays neutral, which is exactly why it survives.
items.cn: 贸易、教育与军事让这个词持续活跃：海外市场、留学生、海外部署。它的地理框架保持中性，这也正是它存活下来的原因。

note.en: The first group collects over- words that look similar but do not mean across the sea. The second compares words for foreignness and distance.
note.cn: 第一组是同样带 over-、外形相近却不表示“隔海”的词。第二组比较表示“异国、远方”的词。

entries.definition: to watch over and supervise work or people. It sounds almost the same but has no sea in it.
entries.definitionCN: 监督、管理工作的进行。读音几乎相同，但里面没有 sea。

entries.definition: larger than the standard size. It shares over- and the -size ending but means excess, not distance.
entries.definitionCN: 超过标准尺寸的。它同样带 over- 和 -size 结尾，但表示“过大”，而不是距离。

entries.definition: to express something more strongly than is justified. Its over- means too much, not across.
entries.definitionCN: 把话说得过头；夸大。它的 over- 表示“过分”，不是“越过”。

entries.definition: a loose garment worn over other clothes. It is over + all, and the plural -s can be mistaken for the -s of overseas.
entries.definitionCN: 穿在其他衣服外面的宽松工装。它是 over + all，复数 -s 容易被误当成 overseas 的 -s。

entries.definition: in or to a foreign country. It is only an adverb, while overseas can also be an adjective and a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 在外国、到外国。它只能作副词，而 overseas 还能作形容词和名词。

entries.definition: belonging to a country other than one's own. It is the plain adjective and needs no sea, while overseas keeps the maritime image.
entries.definitionCN: 属于本国以外国家的。它是最朴素的形容词，不需要海；overseas 则保留了航海意象。

entries.definition: involving two or more nations. It stresses relations between states, while overseas stresses distance from home.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及两个或多个国家的。它强调国家之间的关系，overseas 强调与本土的距离。

entries.definition: away from the shore, especially of islands used for financial reasons. It is about distance from land, not about another country.
entries.definitionCN: 离岸的，尤指用于金融目的的海岛。它说的是离开陆地，而不是到另一个国家。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the over + sea picture, then three abstract images about distance and how it is used.
normalIntro.cn: 先用五个围绕 over + sea 画面的挂钩，再用三个关于距离及其用法的抽象画面。

normal.en: Say it as over-seas: over the seas, not over the sees. The plural seas are the water you cross.
normal.cn: 把它读成 over-seas：越过一片片海，而不是 over the sees。复数 seas 就是你越过的水。

normal.en: Look at a map: your finger starts on the home coast, crosses blue, and lands on another country. That finger path is overseas.
normal.cn: 看地图：手指从本国海岸出发，越过蓝色，落到另一个国家。那条手指路径就是 overseas。

normal.en: overseas students are students who crossed the sea to study; the sea is in the name, not in their luggage.
normal.cn: overseas students 是越过海来读书的学生；海在名字里，不在他们的行李里。

normal.en: The word has no -ly adverb form because it already works as an adverb: go overseas, live overseas.
normal.cn: 这个词没有 -ly 副词形式，因为它本身就能作副词：go overseas、live overseas。

normal.en: Overseas trade is trade that leaves the harbour; if the goods never touch water, the word still keeps the old picture.
normal.cn: overseas trade 是离开港口的贸易；即使货物从不碰水，这个词仍保留着旧画面。

abstract.en: Overseas is distance turned into a category: the far shore becomes an administrative box.
abstract.cn: overseas 是把距离变成一个分类：远岸被装进一个行政抽屉。

abstract.en: Every overseas is someone's home. The word marks the speaker's shore, not an absolute edge of the world.
abstract.cn: 每一个“海外”都是某些人的家。这个词标记的是说话者的海岸，而不是世界的绝对边缘。

abstract.en: The word is neutral geography doing political work: it can name a colony without saying colony.
abstract.cn: 这个词让中性的地理替政治干活：它可以指殖民地，却不必说出 colony。

examples.en: The firm opened an overseas office in Osaka last spring.
examples.cn: 这家公司去年春天在大阪开设了海外办事处。

examples.en: Many overseas students work part-time while they improve their English.
examples.cn: 许多留学生在提高英语的同时做兼职。

examples.en: The letters went overseas by ship and took six weeks to arrive.
examples.cn: 这些信件经海路寄往海外，走了六周才到。

dict_mnemonic.note: 把 over 记成“越过”，sea 记成“海”：越过海的那一边，就是海外。
dict_mnemonic.text: over（越过）+ sea（海）+ -s → 海外的、在海外；海外地区

root: over（越过）+ sea（海）；sea 是日耳曼语固有词，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: The senses follow the direction of travel: first something sits on the far shore, then it comes toward the speaker, then the word becomes a path, a named region, an official portfolio, a way of living, a military station, and finally a polite imperial word for the colonies.
sensesIntro.cn: 这些义项顺着旅行的方向展开：先有东西位于远岸，再有东西朝说话者这边来，随后这个词变成一条路径、一块被命名的地区、一份官方职责、一种居住方式、一处军事驻地，最后成为帝国辞令里对殖民地的委婉说法。

core.en: A coastline, a band of water, and another land on the far side
core.cn: 一条海岸线、一条水带，以及水那边另一块陆地

branches.en: A place across the sea: the word locates something abroad.
branches.cn: 海那边的地方：这个词指某物位于国外。

branches.en: From a path to a place: the adverb of movement becomes a named region.
branches.cn: 从路径到地方：表示移动的副词变成一块被命名的地区。

branches.en: The official sphere: foreign affairs at a desk, and troops in the field.
branches.cn: 官方领域：办公桌上的对外事务，以及战场上的海外驻军。

branches.en: People: those who live and work across the sea.
branches.cn: 人：在海外生活与工作的那些人。

branches.en: Origin and old tongue: goods that come from across the sea, and the older British label for the colonies.
branches.cn: 来源与旧称：从海那边来的货物，以及英国旧时对殖民地的说法。

intro.en: Overseas is built from the over- prefix and the sea family. The items below include both true relatives and the nearest sea compounds, so the boundary of the family is visible.
intro.cn: overseas 由 over- 前缀和 sea 词族构成。下面既有真正的同族词，也有最接近的海事复合词，以便看清词族的边界。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entry applies: over is Old English ofer (PIE *uper), and sea is Old English sæ, from Proto-Germanic *saiwiz, whose deeper origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 不适用拉丁词条：over 是古英语 ofer（原始印欧语 *uper），sea 是古英语 sæ，来自原始日耳曼语 *saiwiz，其更早来源不确定。

items.meaning: across the sea; in or from a foreign country
items.meaningCN: 隔海；在海外或来自海外

items.meaning: the earlier adjective and adverb, now mostly replaced
items.meaningCN: 较早的形容词与副词形式，现已多被取代
items.example: An oversea cable was laid in 1866.
items.exampleCN: 一条海底电缆于 1866 年铺设。

items.meaning: the salt water that covers most of the earth
items.meaningCN: 覆盖地球大部分区域的咸水
items.example: The sea was calm that morning.
The seaward window caught the wind.

items.meaning: working or traveling on the sea
items.example: A seafaring family kept the old charts.
items.exampleCN: 一个航海世家保存着旧海图。

items.meaning: away from the shore; of financial islands
items.meaningCN: 离岸的；金融意义上的离岸

items.example: A transoceanic flight takes twelve hours.
items.exampleCN: 跨洋飞行需要十二小时。

definition_zh: 监督；监管；照管；负责（工作、项目或场所）
definition_en: to be in charge of work or an activity and watch that it is done properly
core_image: 一个人站在脚手架的高处，俯看整片工地
scene: 老屋翻修时，房主每周去看一次，检查砖缝、木料与工期是否按图纸走。A retired engineer oversees the restoration of the old house.
sceneCN: 这里 oversee 指对一项工作负总责并持续查看（第 1 个义项：看管他人的工作）；句意：一位退休工程师监督这座老屋的修复。图中可辨识物件：脚手架、图纸、砖缝、木料堆。

derivatives.zh: 监工；监督者
监督；疏忽
受监督的
监督工作

senses.title: Watch over the work of others
senses.definition: to watch people at work and see that they do it correctly
senses.definitionCN: 看着别人做事，确保他们做得正确
senses.example: She oversees the packing line every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上看管包装线。
senses.why: Over and see say exactly what the word does: an eye placed above the hands.
senses.whyCN: 「在上」与「看见」两个构件把词义说得直白：一只眼放在一双手的上方。

senses.title: Be in charge of a whole operation
senses.definition: to hold responsibility for how an operation as a whole is run
senses.definitionCN: 对一个整体运作如何运转承担责任
senses.example: He oversees the whole depot, from deliveries to repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 他从送货到维修，负责整个仓库。
senses.why: Responsibility follows the wider view: whoever sees the whole must answer for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 责任跟着视野走：看得见整体的人，就要为整体负责。

senses.title: Check production quality
senses.definition: to watch a production process and check that output meets the standard
senses.definitionCN: 看住生产过程，核查产出是否达标
senses.example: A technician oversees the coating so no panel leaves too thin.
senses.exampleCN: 一名技术员监督涂层，不让任何面板过薄出厂。
senses.why: Overseeing a process means watching the rule being applied, not watching a person.
senses.whyCN: 监督一个流程，是看着规则被执行，而不是看着某个人。

senses.title: Manage a project or event
senses.titleCN: 把一个项目或活动管到底
senses.definition: to carry responsibility for a project or event from its start to its finish
senses.definitionCN: 对一个项目或活动从开始到结束负责
senses.example: Two volunteers oversee the summer fair from the first letter to the last bill.
senses.exampleCN: 两名志愿者从第一封信到最后一张账单，把夏季集市管到底。
senses.why: A project has a beginning and an end, and the word covers the whole span between them.
senses.whyCN: 项目有起点也有终点，这个词覆盖了两者之间的整段时间。

senses.title: Look after a property
senses.definition: to keep an eye on a house or piece of land for its owner
senses.definitionCN: 替业主看住一栋房子或一块土地
senses.example: A neighbour oversees the flat while the family is abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人出国期间，一位邻居照看那套公寓。
senses.why: The same eye can be lent to a place rather than to people, and then it means keeping it safe.
senses.whyCN: 同一只眼也能借给一处地方而不是人，那时它的意思就是让它保持安好。

senses.title: Watch a vote or count for fairness
senses.titleCN: 为保证公正而监督投票或计票
senses.definition: to watch a vote or a count so that the result is honest
senses.definitionCN: 看住投票或计票过程，使结果诚实可信
senses.example: Independent observers oversaw the recount.
senses.exampleCN: 独立观察员监督了重新计票。
senses.why: Where trust is thin, the eye is invited in from outside to stand above the process.
senses.whyCN: 在信任薄弱之处，会从外面请一只眼来站到流程上方。

senses.title: Supervise a long piece of research
senses.definition: to guide and check a student's or colleague's extended research
senses.definitionCN: 指导并核查学生或同事长期进行的研究
senses.example: The professor oversees four doctoral projects at once.
senses.exampleCN: 这位教授同时指导四个博士项目。
senses.why: Slow work needs an eye that returns again and again rather than one that stays.
senses.whyCN: 缓慢的工作需要一只反复回来的眼，而不是一直守着的眼。

senses.title: Watch a building site
senses.definition: to watch construction work so that it follows the drawings and the safety rules
senses.definitionCN: 看管施工，使工程依图纸与安全规定进行
senses.example: The clerk of works oversees every pour of concrete.
senses.exampleCN: 工程监督员监督每一次混凝土浇筑。
senses.why: On a site the drawings and the rules are both visible, so the eye compares two things at once.
senses.whyCN: 工地上图纸与规定都看得见，因此这只眼同时比对两样东西。

intro.en: Oversee is a plain English compound of over and see, modelled on the Latin verb supervidere. It has always meant to look over work, and it keeps a clean distance from the double sense of overlook.
intro.cn: oversee 是由 over 与 see 构成的英语本族复合词，模仿拉丁 supervidere 而造。它始终表示「从上方看着工作」，并与 overlook 的双重含义保持了清楚的距离。

items.en: Ofer meant 'over, above', and English kept the physical picture of a gaze coming from a higher place.
items.cn: ofer 意为「在上、越过」，英语保留了目光来自较高处的具体画面。

items.en: Seon 'to see' became our see; its past forms gave sight and the modern seen.
items.cn: seon「看见」演变为今天的 see；它的过去形式衍生出 sight 与现代的 seen。

items.en: Over and see were joined in Middle English, generally thought to be a loan translation of Latin supervidere rather than a borrowed word.
items.cn: over 与 see 在中古英语合成一词，一般认为是对拉丁 supervidere 的仿译，而不是借用词。

items.en: The compound first meant to look over a place or a body of workers, and that supervisory sense has stayed central.
items.cn: 这个复合词最初指从上方看一处地方或一群工人，这一监督义一直是核心。

items.en: Overlook also means to fail to notice, while oversee never does; the two compounds divided the work of the Latin model between them.
items.cn: overlook 还兼指漏看，而 oversee 从不这样用；两个复合词把拉丁原型的工作分掉了。

items.en: The first recorded uses are not precisely dated; the word is attested from the late Middle Ages, and the date is approximate.
items.cn: 最早记录的使用年代并不精确；这个词自中古后期已有记录，年代为约数。

note.en: The first group shares the two English pieces or a near shape; the second group holds verbs of watching and running.
note.cn: 第一组共享两个英语构件或形音相近；第二组是表示看管与经营的动词。

entries.definition: The person who oversees, especially on a plantation or a worksite.
entries.definitionCN: 负责监督的人，尤指种植园或工地上的监工。

entries.definition: The noun of the role, and also a failure to notice something.
entries.definitionCN: 指这一角色的名词，同时也指漏看。

entries.definition: The noun of seeing, from the same verb that gives the second half of oversee.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「看见」的名词，与 oversee 的后半同出那个动词。

entries.definition: Built from over and look; it means both to have a view over and to fail to notice, which oversee never means.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「在上」与表示「看」的构件构成；既指俯瞰，也指漏看，而 oversee 没有后一义。

entries.definition: The Latin-derived twin, often a little more formal.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁来源的对应词，通常稍正式。

entries.definition: A formal verb for holding charge of an operation.
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语，指掌管一项运作。

entries.definition: Watch continuously, usually for signs of change, without necessarily having authority.
entries.definitionCN: 持续观察，通常留意变化迹象，未必拥有权力。

entries.definition: Run the work and its people; oversee stresses the watching more than the running.
entries.definitionCN: 经营工作及其人员；oversee 更强调看而不是经营。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the two real English pieces and the real word family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用两个真实的英语构件与真实的同族词。

normal.en: Over plus see is the whole word: an eye above the hands.
normal.cn: 「在上」加「看见」就是整个词：一双眼在一双手上方。

normal.en: The family runs overseer, oversight, oversaw and overseen.
normal.cn: 同族词有 overseer、oversight、oversaw 与 overseen。

normal.en: It is the English twin of supervise, built from native pieces instead of Latin ones.
normal.cn: 它是 supervise 的英语对应词，用本族构件而不是拉丁构件造成。

normal.en: Real objects are a project, a site, a count, a property and a process.
normal.cn: 它的真实宾语是项目、工地、计票、房产与流程。

normal.en: Overlook took the 'fail to notice' sense, leaving oversee to mean only watching.
normal.cn: overlook 拿走了「漏看」那一义，把 oversee 留作纯粹的看着。

abstract.en: Picture a figure on scaffolding who sees the whole roof at one glance.
abstract.cn: 想象脚手架上的人一眼看见整个屋顶。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that never holds a tool but always points to the next joint.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从不拿工具，却总指向下一个接缝。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp on a pole that lights the whole yard and no single bench.
abstract.cn: 想象杆上的一盏灯照亮整个院子，却不专照某一张台。

examples.en: A committee of three oversees the rebuilding of the bridge.
examples.cn: 一个三人委员会监督这座桥的重建。

examples.en: She oversees the training of every new mechanic.
examples.cn: 她负责监督每名新技工的培训。

examples.en: The bank asked an outside firm to oversee the transfer.
examples.cn: 银行请了一家外部公司监督这次交接。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「over（在上）+ see（看）」——在上方看着，就是监督

root: 英语本族复合词：表示「在上」的构件 + 表示「看」的构件，一般认为是对拉丁 supervidere「巡视」的仿译；同族词有 overseer、oversight、overseen。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep the eye above: it watches hands, answers for a whole depot, checks a process, carries a project, guards a flat, attends a recount, follows a doctorate and compares concrete with drawings.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都让眼留在上方：看住一双手、为整个仓库负责、核查一个流程、把一个项目管到底、照看一套公寓、到场监督重新计票、跟上博士研究、把混凝土与图纸对照。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure on the scaffolding who sees the whole site at one glance.
core.cn: 核心意象：脚手架上的一个人，一眼看见整片工地。

branches.en: HANDS AND PROCESS: watching people work, and watching a rule being applied.
branches.cn: 人与流程：看着人干活，也看着规则被执行。

branches.en: THE WHOLE: responsibility grows with the width of the view.
branches.cn: 整体：视野有多宽，责任就有多大。

branches.en: FROM START TO FINISH: a project's whole span, and a site checked pour by pour.
branches.cn: 从头到尾：项目的整段时间，以及逐次浇筑核查的工地。

branches.en: THE EMPTY FLAT: the eye lent to a place instead of to people.
branches.cn: 空置的公寓：这只眼借给地方，而不是借给人。

branches.en: OUTSIDE EYES: a recount and a doctorate both need an eye from beyond the work.
branches.cn: 外来的眼：重新计票与博士研究都需要一只来自工作之外的眼。

intro.en: Oversee is built only from English pieces, so it has no Latin ancestors; the Latin verb it copies is given as a model, not as a source.
intro.cn: oversee 完全由英语构件构成，因此没有拉丁祖先；它模仿的那个拉丁动词只作为样板列出，不是来源。

latinIntro.en: The two pieces are over and see; the Latin model supervidere is shown for comparison, not as an origin.
latinIntro.cn: 两个构件是 over 与 see；拉丁样板 supervidere 仅作对照，并非来源。

items.example: The agent ending names the person.
The noun picked up the negative sense as well.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词也承接了否定的一面。

items.meaning: the act or power of seeing

items.example: The participle marks the work that has been checked.
items.exampleCN: 分词标出已被核查的工作。

definition_zh: 加班；加班费；加时赛；超时的
definition_en: time worked beyond one's regular working hours, or a period of extra play added when a game is tied
core_image: 下班铃响过之后，灯还亮着，时间被往后多拨了一段
scene: 项目截止日期快到了，同事们下班后仍在加班。The whole team worked overtime to finish the project before the deadline.
sceneCN: 这里 overtime 是「加班；超时工作」（第 1 个义项：超出正常工作的时间）；句意：为了在截止日期前完成项目，全队都在加班。

pos.zh: 加班时间；加班费；加时赛

derivatives.zh: over（过度）+ work（工作），义为「过度劳累；使工作过量」，侧重过量而非超时
基础词 over 本身，义为「在……之上；超过」，是构词的来源成分
part（部分）+ time（时间），义为「兼职的」，与 overtime 的「全职额外时间」形成对照
full（全部）+ time（时间），义为「全职的」，指正常工作时段
time（时间）+ -ly 后缀，义为「及时的」，与 overtime 共享 time 词根

senses.title: Time worked beyond regular hours
senses.definition: time spent working in addition to one's normal working hours
senses.definitionCN: 在正常工作时间之外继续工作的时间
senses.example: The staff were angry because they had to work overtime every week.
senses.exampleCN: 员工们很生气，因为他们每周都得加班。
senses.why: The core image is time pushed beyond a boundary; the working day has an edge, and overtime is what spills over it.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是时间越过边界：工作日有一条「界线」，overtime 就是漫出这条界线的那部分时间。

senses.title: Extra pay for extra hours
senses.definition: payment, usually at a higher rate, made for hours worked beyond the regular schedule
senses.definitionCN: 对超出正常工时的工作所支付的报酬，通常按更高费率计算
senses.example: She earns double overtime on public holidays.
senses.exampleCN: 她在法定节假日能拿到双倍加班费。
senses.why: Because the extra time costs the worker more, the word naturally extends to the money that compensates that time.
senses.whyCN: 多出的时间意味着更大的付出，于是这个词自然延伸到「补偿这段时间的钱」，即加班费。

senses.title: Extra playing time in a tied game
senses.definition: an additional period of play added when a sports game ends in a tie, to decide the winner
senses.definitionCN: 体育比赛打成平局后追加的比赛时段，用于决出胜负
senses.example: The game went into overtime after a scoreless second half.
senses.exampleCN: 下半场双方均未进球，比赛进入加时赛。
senses.why: A tied game has used up its allotted time but lacks a result, so more time must be granted — the same 'time beyond the limit' image.
senses.whyCN: 平局意味着规定时间用完却仍无结果，只能再「拨」一段时间——依旧是「超出限定的时间」这一核心意象。

senses.title: Beyond the usual or expected time
senses.definition: lasting or continuing longer than the time that was planned or agreed
senses.definitionCN: 持续的时间超过原定或约定的时间
senses.example: The negotiations ran overtime and finished near midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判超时了，快到午夜才结束。
senses.why: Once a schedule sets a limit, any excess is measured against it; overtime names whatever runs past the mark.
senses.whyCN: 日程一旦划定了限线，超出的部分就要以它为参照来衡量；overtime 指的就是越过刻度的那段时间。

senses.title: Working or done beyond regular hours
senses.definition: relating to or taking place during hours worked beyond the normal schedule
senses.definitionCN: 与超出正常工时的工作相关的；发生在加班时间里的
senses.example: He claimed overtime pay for the overtime hours he logged.
senses.exampleCN: 他为自己记录的加班时间申请了加班费。
senses.why: The noun hardens into an adjective when the phrase is used to label things — hours, pay, rules — connected with extra time.
senses.whyCN: 当名词被用来给「工时、报酬、规定」等事物贴标签时，就固化成了形容词，表示「属于加班时段的」。

senses.title: To work beyond regular hours
senses.definition: to work more hours than the regular schedule requires
senses.definitionCN: 工作的时间超出正常排班的要求
senses.example: The warehouse overtimes during the holiday rush every year.
senses.exampleCN: 每逢节假日旺季，仓库都要加班。
senses.why: English freely turns compounds like this into verbs; the action of spending extra time becomes the activity itself.
senses.whyCN: 英语习惯把这类复合词转成动词，「花费额外时间」这一状态被直接当作动作来说。

senses.title: Excess or surplus time in general
senses.definition: any amount of time that exceeds what was allotted or expected
senses.definitionCN: 任何超出原有分配或预期的额外时间
senses.example: The recording captured ten minutes of overtime beyond the planned interview.
senses.exampleCN: 录音比计划采访时多录了十分钟的超时内容。
senses.why: Stripped of work and sport, the word keeps its bare arithmetic: allotted time plus whatever spills over.
senses.whyCN: 去掉工作和比赛的语境，这个词保留了最朴素的算术含义：规定时间，加上漫出来的那部分。

senses.title: Long beyond what is reasonable
senses.definition: used to stress that something continues for far longer than is sensible or healthy
senses.definitionCN: 用来强调某事持续得远超合理或健康的限度
senses.example: Working overtime night after night, she slowly wore herself down.
senses.exampleCN: 夜复一夜地超时工作，她慢慢把自己拖垮了。
senses.why: The prefix over- already hints at 'too much'; repeated or extreme overtime shades from neutral description into warning.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 over- 本身带「过度」的暗示；反复或极端的超时让这个词从中性描述滑向警示意味。

intro.en: Overtime is a transparent English compound of over and time, built within English rather than borrowed.
intro.cn: overtime 是由 over 与 time 直接复合成的英语本族词，并非外来借词。

items.en: The reconstructed root *uper, meaning 'over, above', underlies over; a separate root *deh₂- 'to divide' is traditionally linked with time through the notion of divided periods.
items.cn: 重构词根 *uper（意为「在上、越过」）是 over 的来源；time 则一般认为可追溯到 *deh₂-「切分」，与「划分出的时段」概念相关（此联系属传统推测）。

items.en: Old English had ofer 'over, above' and tīma 'limited space of time, season'; both were core everyday words.
items.cn: 古英语已有 ofer（在上、越过）与 tīma（有限的时间段、时节），两者都是日常核心词。

items.en: The compound idea of 'time beyond' appears in phrases before the fused form; over + time combinations surface in late Middle English contexts of exceeding set periods.
items.cn: 「超出之时」的概念先以短语形式出现，over 与 time 的复合形式在晚期中古英语「超出约定期限」的语境中露头。

items.en: By the 17th century overtime is recorded for time exceeding an allowance or deadline; the industrial workplace later fixed its labour sense, and 19th-century sport added the tie-breaker sense.
items.cn: 17 世纪起 overtime 已用于指超出配额或期限的时间；后来工业化职场固定了其劳动含义，19 世纪体育又衍生出平局决胜的加时义。

items.en: Today overtime covers extra work hours, the pay for them, extra sports periods, and adjectival or adverbial uses, all from one image: time past the limit.
items.cn: 如今 overtime 兼指加班时间、加班费、体育加时，并可用作形容词和副词，全部源自同一意象：越过限度的时间。

note.en: Overtime looks simple, but it sits inside a busy family of over- compounds and time words that learners often mix up.
note.cn: overtime 看似简单，却身处 over- 复合词与 time 词族的密集地带，学习者容易混淆。

entries.definition: to work too much, or excessive work
entries.definitionCN: 过度工作；劳累过度——与 overtime 同用 over- 前缀，但侧重「量过多」而非「时超限」

entries.definition: above one's head, or regular business costs not tied to output
entries.definitionCN: 头顶上方的；（企业）日常经费、管理费用——只与 overtime 拼写相近、同含 over-，词义完全不同

entries.definition: an unintentional failure to notice, or the supervision of work
entries.definitionCN: 疏忽；监管——形近词，共享 over- 前缀但语义走向不同

entries.definition: hours worked in addition to the normal schedule
entries.definitionCN: 额外的工时——与 overtime 第 1 义几乎等义的口语说法

entries.definition: additional time, especially added to a tied football match (British usage)
entries.definitionCN: 加时（英式足球常用说法）——与美式 overtime 的加时赛义对应

entries.definition: working fewer hours than a full schedule
entries.definitionCN: 兼职的、非全日的——与 overtime 的「超出全职工时」形成反向对照

normalIntro.en: Break the word into its two honest parts and the meanings fall into place.
normalIntro.cn: 把这个词拆成老实的两半，各种义项便各归其位。

normal.en: over + time = time that goes over the limit.
normal.cn: over（越过）+ time（时间）＝越过限度的那段时间。

normal.en: The factory whistle blows, but the clock keeps running — that extra run is overtime.
normal.cn: 下班哨声已响，钟却还在走——多走的那段就是「加班」。

normal.en: Overtime pay: the extra time was sold, so the extra time is bought back at a higher price.
normal.cn: 加班费：多卖的时间，自然要按更高的价买回来。

normal.en: Score tied, clock at zero, referee adds five more minutes: overtime in sport.
normal.cn: 比分持平、时钟归零、裁判再补五分钟：这就是体育里的「加时赛」。

normal.en: Family: overwork (too much work), overhead (above the head / fixed costs), overtime (beyond the time limit).
normal.cn: 词族：overwork（工作过量）、overhead（头顶／管理费用）、overtime（超过时限）。

abstract.en: Picture a glass of water filled to the line, then one more drop makes it spill — the spilled minutes are overtime.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯水已到刻度线，再多一滴就溢出——溢出的那几分钟就是「超时」。

abstract.en: Imagine a rubber band of time stretched past its marking: taut, extra, costing more.
abstract.cn: 想象时间的橡皮筋被拉过刻度：绷紧、超额、代价更高。

abstract.en: See the office lights still on after everyone leaves — one lamp glowing late is overtime made visible.
abstract.cn: 看见人走光后办公室仍亮着的灯——深夜独亮的一盏灯就是「加班」的具象。

examples.en: The engineers worked overtime for three weeks to launch the product on schedule.
examples.cn: 工程师们连续加班三周，好让产品如期上线。

examples.en: Workers who put in overtime are legally entitled to overtime pay.
examples.cn: 加班的员工依法有权获得加班费。

examples.en: The final went into overtime, and the crowd refused to leave their seats.
examples.cn: 决赛进入加时赛，观众们不肯离开座位。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧瓦·太姆」——「哦哇，太‘叹’了！」下班点早过了还要干，员工一声哀叹：又要加班了，时间真是‘太’漫出‘界’了。

root: overtime 是英语本族复合词：over（古英语 ofer，源自原始印欧语重构词根 *uper「在上、越过」）+ time（古英语 tīma「有限时段」，一般认为与原始印欧语 *deh₂-「切分」相关，此联系属传统推测）。字面义即「越过限度的时间」，加班、加班费、加时赛等义项均由此长出。

sensesIntro.en: From the bare image of time past a limit, the word grows into work hours, extra pay, sports extra periods, and beyond.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「越过限度的时间」这一朴素意象出发，词义依次长出加班工时、加班报酬、体育加时以及引申的「过久」等义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: time spilling over a fixed boundary
core.cn: 核心意象：时间漫过一条固定界线

branches.en: A schedule sets the boundary, and the hours worked past it are overtime.
branches.cn: 日程划出界线，界线之外继续工作的时数就是「加班」（义项 01）。

branches.en: The spilled hours are compensated at a higher rate: overtime pay.
branches.cn: 漫出的时间按更高费率补偿，即「加班费」（义项 02）。

branches.en: A tied game needs more minutes to find a winner: overtime in sport.
branches.cn: 平局的比赛需要再补时间决胜负，即体育「加时赛」（义项 03）。

branches.en: Any excess beyond what was allotted, in talks or recordings, is overtime.
branches.cn: 谈判、录音等场合超出原定安排的部分也是「超时／多余时间」（义项 04 · 07）。

branches.en: As adjective, verb, or warning, overtime names work beyond limits and the toll of too much of it.
branches.cn: 作形容词、动词或带警示意味时，overtime 指「超时的工作」及其「过久」的代价（义项 05 · 06 · 08）。

intro.en: Overtime is built from a native prefix-like adverb and a native noun; the same parts spawn a large compound family.
intro.cn: overtime 由本族的副词性成分与本族名词复合而成，同样的构件派生出一个庞大的复合词家族。

latinIntro.en: Although the compound itself is Germanic, the underlying parts connect to Latin kin through the shared Indo-European heritage.
latinIntro.cn: 复合词本身虽属日耳曼系统，但其底层成分通过印欧共同遗产与拉丁语同族词遥相呼应。

items.exampleCN: overflow（溢出）——暴雨过后河水漫过堤岸

items.exampleCN: timetable（时刻表）——上车前先查时刻表

The new brand overtook its rival in sales

items.meaning: fail to notice, or have a view over
